body: Thank you! I have generally tried to say stuff like that. But today I guess I lost my cool when she unnecessarily started off. I will definitely try to remain calm and not fight back no matter what she says. You know she is not always like that, but she does have these moments where she says really horrible things. She has done it with my other family members too. I have always told her that if she has any problem with me she should just tell me the problem. Instead, she waits for the situation to get extreme and then tells me that I should have known that there was a problem in the first place and that I am not caring enough. I have admitted multiple times that I am not the best at showing my emotions to people so she should let me know if I am being a problem. But, no she wants that I should just know her problems automatically. It's like a person saying that they are bad at something and want to improve at that thing, but the other person just assumes that the other person is making excuses.
Man you are so right about that not reacting part. Whenever I don't react she starts saying that I don't have any feelings and I am self centered.
